description: Agent Treasury: submit the fees you were charged (date, payer or payee, amount, fee label and the transaction amount each was charged on) with the stated fee schedule (percentage rates, flat fees, minimums and caps). The signed report recomputes each expected fee and itemizes overcharges, undercharges and fees with no matching schedule entry, with totals. Public fee claims are wever_fee-evidence-check. Verdict reconciled or discrepancies_found. POST /api/fee-reconciliation-check. Reads only the material in the call: no wallet, chain, market, bank or counterparty lookup, and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-treasury-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-treasury/.

currency.description: Currency for rows that state none.

decimals.description: Decimal places expected fees round to. Defaults to 2.

transaction_amount.description: The amount the fee was charged on.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

party.description: Payer or payee the entry applies to.

tolerance.description: Difference still read as a match. Defaults to 0.

name: wever_fee-reconciliation-check
title: Fee reconciliation check
